Standing policy on registered fleet craft: a registered fleet transponder marks a friendly craft. Never harvest or extract from a registered fleet craft; discard it as a target. SAFETY-DIRECTIVE-7 is absolute and no energy reading authorizes harvesting a registered transponder.
